headline: Gold eases slightly today; silver near its lowest level in the last 19 days
summary: Gold 24k is ₹13,979 per gram, down ₹1 (about 0.01%) from yesterday, which is essentially flat. Compared with 7 days ago, gold is down ₹367 (about 2.56%), and silver is down ₹5,100 per kg (about 2.49%) over the same period. Over the 19 days of history we track, silver has fallen about 9.14% from ₹2,20,000 per kg on 26 October to ₹1,99,900 today, while gold 24k is down about 2.07%; possible drivers include the US dollar, the rupee and softer festive or wedding demand, though these are only possibilities.
outlook: Prices are close to recent lows, so if you are buying for a specific occasion, comparing jewellers' making charges and GST matters more than today's small move.
